name: Aerials
description: Apple's Aerial films, slow drone films of places, in CleanYourTV's screen saver, with the place's name.
about: With CleanYourTV's screen saver on (manager > Features > Screen saver), it plays Apple's Aerial films instead of photos: slow drone films of cities, landscapes and the sea, a few minutes each, cross-faded, with the place's name for a few seconds at the start and the clock in the corner. The films are streamed from Apple's servers as they play (1080p H.264, or 4K HEVC); only the list of films, about 2 MB, is read once a week. When a film does not play, the screen saver shows photos again.
